A '''Republic base''' was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] using it as its base of operations for a [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|battle]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|116}}</ref>
